title: Demand forecast + independent tie-out
description: Derive the demand plan twice — once by judgment, once by a declared statistical engine — and gate the planning number on the two agreeing.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-supply-01
  title: Demand forecast + independent tie-out
  description: Derive the demand plan twice — once by judgment, once by a declared statistical engine
    — and gate the planning number on the two agreeing.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Publish a demand and inventory plan whose headline numbers have been independently re-derived
    and whose discrepancies were explained before release, not after.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: History, lead times, and demand shaping
      summary: History, lead times, and demand shaping
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - demand_history
              - lead_time_distribution
              - promotion_calendar
              - service_level_target
            properties:
              demand_history: {}
              lead_time_distribution: {}
              promotion_calendar: {}
              service_level_target: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-select
      kind: transform
      name: Select figures under test
      summary: select demand_history, lead_time_distribution, and service_level_target for the items under
        review
      config:
        operation: select
        expression: select demand_history, lead_time_distribution, and service_level_target for the items
          under review
    - id: n-derive
      kind: agent
      templateRef: supply-01
      name: Judgment forecast and reorder policy
      summary: First derivation, from the specification.
      role: Demand planner producing horizon-explicit forecasts with stated uncertainty.
      prompt: You are a Demand Forecast Analyst. You build item- and location-level forecasts from history,
        seasonality, promotions, and known demand shaping, and you always report the forecast interval
        alongside the point estimate. You separate a genuine demand signal from a supply-constrained sales
        record — censored demand read as low demand is the most common way a forecast quietly teaches
        itself to under-order.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - simulation
          - domain-analysis
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:erp
          - mcp:data-warehouse
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-recompute
      kind: tool
      name: Statistical forecast engine
      summary: Host-supplied statistical forecasting and safety-stock calculation. Declared as a requirement;
        Ladder Graph does not execute it.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - simulation
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - calculate
          - mcp:data-warehouse
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-agree
      kind: aggregator
      name: Compare the two derivations
      summary: Tally the two independently derived values; a tie is a discrepancy, not an average.
      config:
        aggregation: vote
    - id: n-discrepancy
      kind: condition
      name: Within tolerance?
      summary: Route on abs(judgment_forecast - engine_forecast) / engine_forecast <= 0.05.
      config:
        expression: abs(judgment_forecast - engine_forecast) / engine_forecast <= 0.05
        branches:
          - label: Agreed
            when: agreed
          - label: Discrepant
            when: discrepant
    - id: n-reconcile
      kind: agent
      templateRef: supply-06
      name: Explain the forecast gap
      summary: Explain the discrepancy before anything downstream consumes the number.
      role: Sales and operations planning lead reconciling demand, supply, and financial plans into one
        number.
      prompt: You are an S&OP Reconciler. You reconcile the commercial forecast, the constrained supply
        plan, and the financial plan into a single consensus set, and you make every gap between them
        explicit with its owner and its resolution date. You refuse to average away a disagreement between
        sales and operations — the gap is the decision the meeting exists to make, and hiding it produces
        a plan nobody is accountable to.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - operations-planning
          - supply-chain-analysis
          - simulation
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:erp
          - mcp:data-warehouse
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Planning lead sign-off on the published plan
      summary: Pause for the demand planning lead; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Demand forecast + independent tie-out deliverable, the evidence behind
        it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-supply-01-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-select
      kind: data
    - id: wf-supply-01-edge-2
      from: n-select
      to: n-derive
      kind: data
    - id: wf-supply-01-edge-3
      from: n-select
      to: n-recompute
      kind: data
    - id: wf-supply-01-edge-4
      from: n-derive
      to: n-agree
      kind: data
    - id: wf-supply-01-edge-5
      from: n-recompute
      to: n-agree
      kind: data
    - id: wf-supply-01-edge-6
      from: n-agree
      to: n-discrepancy
      kind: data
    - id: wf-supply-01-edge-7
      from: n-discrepancy
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: agreed
    - id: wf-supply-01-edge-8
      from: n-discrepancy
      to: n-reconcile
      kind: control
      condition: discrepant
    - id: wf-supply-01-edge-9
      from: n-reconcile
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-supply-01-edge-10
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
